book.title: Sarra and the Little Lost Roar
book.description: An original watercolor listening adventure made for Sarra. A little lion has lost his roar; a friend who listens helps him find his courage. English and French.

arPages.purpose: Meet the cub in the sunlit listening woodland.
An original little songbird flutters its wings over the printed page.
Return to the same woodland beside Owl’s tree, at the same scale.
A small original animated tortoise takes gentle brave steps.
The original cub breathes calmly as he chooses to help his friend.
Celebrate inside the golden river glade, with the same room scale and forward view.
Listen again in the same sunset glade without changing its scale or scene.

typography.sounds: Fredoka 700, existing app colored sound words
typography.note: Story text stays editable and is typeset by the app, never baked into spread artwork.

assumptions: Age not supplied: written for approximately 4–7.
Language not supplied: English with full French reading option.

worlds.world-forest.jpg: A seamless watercolor woodland clearing: cub straight ahead, owl in a gnarled tree to the left, rabbit and elephant further around, small garden gate behind. No lettering.
worlds.world-river.jpg: A seamless golden-hour stream glade: cub, safe twig footbridge and tortoise ahead, elephant, rabbit and owl around the banks, golden fireflies. No lettering.
